description: A top-down clip of a test bench on a station: six one-tile lanes side by side, each split by a firelock between a lower room and an upper area. The upper areas hold, from left to right: an exposed lattice open to space, dense purple gas, fire, fire (behind a glass firelock), purple gas (behind a thin edge firelock), and plain air (the last firelock starts open). The shut firelocks show coloured warning brackets. During the clip the last firelock shuts and purple gas is released above it, and later the second firelock is opened.
